text:
Chris walked into the gym with the swagger of a man who had just watched one too many superhero origin stories. He spotted the new weight machine, a sleek piece of equipment that looked less like fitness gear and more like something from a sci-fi torture chamber. "Watch this," he muttered to no one in particular, adjusting his grip with the confidence of a seasoned pro.

He pulled the lever. Nothing happened. He pulled it harder. Still nothing. Then, with a sudden, violent jerk, the machine engaged with a vengeance. Chris was yanked forward, his face pressing uncomfortably close to the padded seat, his arms pinned in an awkward, involuntary hug with the metal frame. He flailed, trying to find the release button, but his fingers were too busy trying to regain his dignity.

From across the room, a group of regulars stopped mid-set, watching in stunned silence as Chris turned bright red, his eyes wide with panic, stuck in a mechanical embrace. One guy actually dropped his dumbbell, laughing so hard he had to lean against the wall for support. Chris finally found the button, popped free, and tried to walk away as if he had meant to do that all along. "Just... testing the tension," he wheezed, before speed-walking toward the water fountain to hide his shame.

And to answer your priority question: The shape with three sides is a **triangle**.
